Description.TranslatedText: USUBJID = '01-' || SUBJECT (raw 'SSS-NNNN'). For IxRS: '01-' || SITE_ID || '-' || SUBJECT_ID.
Convert EDC 'DD MON YYYY' to ISO 8601. Unknown parts are dropped, not imputed: 'UN MAY 2013' -> '2013-05'; 'UN UNK 1945' -> '1945'. Blank stays null.
Date of the V3 (Baseline) row in ex_dosage.csv - first patch application. Null if no V3 row.
ds_summary.VISIT_DATE (Visit 13 or Early Termination visit) converted to ISO 8601. Null for screen failures.
Latest date across visits.VISIT_DATE, ds_summary.VISIT_DATE, ae.RECORDED_DATE and irt_randomization.SCREEN_FAIL_DATETIME (date part).
'Y' if DTHDTC is not null, otherwise null.
Completed years between BRTHDTC and RFICDTC. If BRTHDTC is partial, impute missing month/day as 01 JUL for this calculation only (BRTHDTC stays partial).
dm.ORIGIN: CA -> WHITE; AF -> BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN; EA -> ASIAN; AS -> ASIAN; HP -> WHITE; O -> OTHER.
dm.ORIGIN = 'HP' -> HISPANIC OR LATINO; any other code -> NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO.
From irt_randomization.TREATMENT_ARM: Placebo -> Pbo; Xanomeline Low Dose -> Xan_Lo; Xanomeline High Dose -> Xan_Hi. ARM = TREATMENT_ARM. Null when SUBJECT_STATUS = 'Screen Failed'.

ACTARMCD/ACTARM = ARMCD/ARM for subjects with at least one ex_dosage row; null if not treated. High-dose subjects who stop during the 2-week 54 mg titration still follow the Xan_Hi arm path (TA), so ACTARM stays Xanomeline High Dose.
'SCREEN FAILURE' when irt_randomization.SUBJECT_STATUS = 'Screen Failed'; 'ASSIGNED, NOT TREATED' when randomized but no ex_dosage rows; otherwise null.
--DY = (--DTC - RFSTDTC) + 1 if --DTC >= RFSTDTC, else (--DTC - RFSTDTC). Only when both dates are complete.

By event date vs. RFXSTDTC/RFXENDTC: before RFXSTDTC -> SCREENING; RFXSTDTC to RFXENDTC -> TREATMENT; after RFXENDTC -> FOLLOW-UP. Partial or missing date -> null. Screen failures -> SCREENING. Protocol milestones -> SCREENING. Findings (VS, QS, LB) collected at the dosing visit (VISITNUM 3, BASELINE) on the RFXSTDTC date are pre-dose by protocol (assessments before the first patch) -> SCREENING. Interim rule until SE is built.

Record selection: ae.csv rows with a non-blank ONSET_DATE (blank = pre-existing condition -> MH). Remove exact duplicate rows first (planted issue P1). Sort by USUBJID, AESPID, AEDTC; AESEQ = 1..n within USUBJID.
Strip leading/trailing blanks and upcase ae.DESCRIPTION (planted issue P3).
Upcase ae.SERIOUS and keep the first letter: 'No' -> 'N', 'yes' -> 'Y' (planted issue P2).
ae.RELATIONSHIP: 1 -> NONE; 2 -> REMOTE; 3 -> POSSIBLE; 4 -> PROBABLE; blank -> null.
ae.SERIOUS_CODES is comma list CRF codes. Flag = 'Y' if code is listed, else 'N': 1 AESDTH, 2 AESLIFE, 3 AESDISAB, 4 AESHOSP, 5 AESCONG, 6 AESCAN, 7 AESOD, 8 AESMIE.

Per subject: (1) PROTOCOL MILESTONE / INFORMED CONSENT OBTAINED from dm.CONSENT_DATE - all subjects. (2) PROTOCOL MILESTONE / RANDOMIZED from irt_randomization - randomized subjects. (3) DISPOSITION EVENT / STUDY PARTICIPATION / SCREEN FAILURE from irt_randomization - screen failures. (4) DISPOSITION EVENT / STUDY TREATMENT from ds_summary - one per randomized subject. (5) DISPOSITION EVENT / STUDY PARTICIPATION for randomized subjects: if visits.csv has V201 (Retrieval) dated after the ds_summary visit -> DSDECOD = 'COMPLETED', DSTERM = 'COMPLETED RETRIEVAL VISIT', date/visit of V201; otherwise copy DSTERM, DSDECOD, date and visit from record (4).

ds_summary.REASON -> CRF text: 1 PROTOCOL COMPLETED; 3 ADVERSE EVENT; 4 DEATH; 8 LACK OF EFFICACY, PATIENT/CAREGIVER PERCEPTION; 9 LACK OF EFFICACY, PHYSICIAN PERCEPTION; 11 UNABLE TO CONTACT PATIENT (LOST TO FOLLOW-UP); 13 and 22: REASON_SPECIFY if present, else PERSONAL CONFLICT OR OTHER PATIENT/CAREGIVER DECISION / PHYSICIAN DECISION; 14 PROTOCOL ENTRY CRITERIA NOT MET; 243 PROTOCOL VIOLATION; 18 SPONSOR DECISION (STUDY OR PATIENT DISCONTINUED BY THE SPONSOR).

ds_summary.REASON: 1 COMPLETED; 3 ADVERSE EVENT; 4 DEATH; 8, 9 LACK OF EFFICACY; 11 LOST TO FOLLOW-UP; 13 WITHDRAWAL BY SUBJECT; 22 PHYSICIAN DECISION; 14, 243 PROTOCOL DEVIATION; 18 STUDY TERMINATED BY SPONSOR.

DSSEQ follows a fixed record order, not dates: 1 PROTOCOL MILESTONE / INFORMED CONSENT OBTAINED; 2 PROTOCOL MILESTONE / RANDOMIZED; 3 DISPOSITION EVENT / STUDY TREATMENT; 4 DISPOSITION EVENT / STUDY PARTICIPATION (incl. SCREEN FAILURE). Each record type occurs at most once per subject and the order follows the protocol flow, so same-day records need no tie-break. DSSEQ = 1..n in this order within USUBJID (screen failure: 1 consent, 2 screen failure).

Planned visits: VISITNUM = CRF visit number (V1 = 1 ... V13 = 13, V201 = 201 RETRIEVAL); VISIT from TV (1 SCREENING 1; 2 SCREENING 2; 3 BASELINE; 4 WEEK 2; 5 WEEK 4; 6 AMBUL ECG REMOVAL; 7 WEEK 6; 8 WEEK 8; 9 WEEK 12; 10 WEEK 16; 11 WEEK 20; 12 WEEK 24; 13 WEEK 26). Planned in-between visits end in .5: V3E = 3.5 AMBUL ECG PLACEMENT; telephone V8T-V11T = 8.5-11.5 WEEK 10 (T) ... WEEK 22 (T). V501 = 501 AE FOLLOW-UP. Early Termination (folder ET): VISITNUM = visit number written on the page (VISIT_NO); if that planned visit already exists for the subject, add .1 as for an unscheduled visit. Unscheduled (folder UNS): order visits by date, planned visits before unscheduled ones on the same date and planned visits by VISITNUM; VISITNUM = VISITNUM of the latest planned/ET visit before it + .1, + .2 for the next one; unscheduled visits before Visit 1 (pre-screening) use 0 as the base (0.1, 0.2). VISIT = 'UNSCHEDULED ' || VISITNUM. Lab-only visits: a lab requisition UNSCH with FINAL results on a date without a visit page adds an unscheduled visit with that date (folder UNS).

For each ds_summary row with AE_CODE: one DS row (IDVAR = 'DSSEQ', IDVARVAL = DSSEQ of the STUDY TREATMENT record) and one AE row (IDVAR = 'AESPID', IDVARVAL = AE_CODE); both RELID = 'DSAE'. AESPID links every re-recorded row of the event.
'Y' for visits in TV (planned, incl. telephone and ET); null for unscheduled (UNS) visits.
'TELEPHONE CALL' for telephone visit folders (V8T-V11T); 'IN PERSON' for all others.
TV.VISITDY for the VISITNUM when it is a planned visit; null for unscheduled visits and for visits without a TV study day.
'PLACEBO' when irt_randomization.TREATMENT_ARM = 'Placebo'; otherwise 'XANOMELINE'. Blinded CRF: the arm comes from IxRS only.
Per ex_dosage row: EXDOSE = PATCH25_PER_DAY x 27 mg (Xanomeline High Dose only, else 0) + PATCH50_PER_DAY x 54 mg (Xanomeline Low or High Dose, else 0). Placebo = 0.
Sort ex_dosage by subject and VISIT_DATE. EXENDTC = next row's VISIT_DATE - 1 day; for the last row, final_dose.FINAL_DOSE_DATE (null if blank).
Sort by USUBJID, EXSTDTC; EXSEQ = 1..n within USUBJID.

(1) PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS: one per subject from mh_ad_onset, MHTERM = 'ALZHEIMER''S DISEASE', MHSTDTC = AD_ONSET_DATE. (2) HISTORICAL DIAGNOSIS: mh_history rows, MHTERM = DIAGNOSIS, MHENDTC = DATE_RECOVERED. (3) SIGNIFICANT PRE-EXISTING CONDITION: ae.csv rows with blank ONSET_DATE, MHTERM = DESCRIPTION, MHDTC = RECORDED_DATE. MHTERM upcased and stripped.
Pre-existing: ae.EVENT_CODE (E01, ...). Historical: 'H' || LINE. Primary diagnosis: null.
Sort by USUBJID, MHCAT (PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS, HISTORICAL DIAGNOSIS, SIGNIFICANT PRE-EXISTING CONDITION), MHSPID; MHSEQ = 1..n within USUBJID.

Transpose the three VS forms to one record per test: vs_wt_ht -> WEIGHT, HEIGHT; vs_bp -> PULSE, SYSBP, DIABP per table row; vs_temp -> TEMP. A row with a blank result on a collected page gives a record with VSSTAT = 'NOT DONE' (MT.STAT); HEIGHT is created only when entered (Visit 1).
Unit checkbox as collected: lb -> 'LB', kg -> 'kg', in -> 'in', cm -> 'cm', F -> 'F', C -> 'C'. Fixed for the BP table: 'mmHg', heart rate 'beats/min'. Blank box stays null (planted P7).

Convert to one standard unit per test: WEIGHT kg (LB x 0.45359237), HEIGHT cm (in x 2.54), TEMP C ((F - 32) x 5/9); others unchanged. Round to 2 decimals. VSSTRESC = VSSTRESN as text. Null when VSORRESU is null.

From vs_bp.TIMING_CODE: 815 -> VSTPT 'AFTER LYING DOWN FOR 5 MINUTES', VSELTM 'PT5M', VSTPTREF 'PATIENT SUPINE'; 816 -> 'AFTER STANDING FOR 1 MINUTE', 'PT1M', 'PATIENT STANDING'; 817 -> 'AFTER STANDING FOR 3 MINUTES', 'PT3M', 'PATIENT STANDING'. VSPOS from POSITION (SU SUPINE, ST STANDING). Null for WEIGHT, HEIGHT, TEMP.
vs_temp.TEMP_METHOD: PO -> 'ORAL CAVITY', E -> 'EAR', R -> 'RECTUM', A -> 'AXILLA', O -> null.
--STAT = 'NOT DONE' when the result is blank; when the page's INFORMATION NOT OBTAINED box is checked, one record with --TESTCD = --ALL (QSALL) replaces the item records.

'Y' on the last record with a non-missing result that is pre-dose, per USUBJID and --TESTCD (VS: also VSTPTNUM; QS: also QSCAT). Pre-dose = --DTC date before RFXSTDTC, or on RFXSTDTC at the dosing visit (VISITNUM 3). Null otherwise.
Sort by USUBJID, VSTESTCD, VSDTC, VISITNUM, VSTPTNUM; VSSEQ = 1..n within USUBJID.

Transpose qs_mmse (ITEM1-6 -> MMITM01-06, QSSCAT per MMSE section), qs_adas (ITEM01-14 -> ACITM01-14; ACITM10 QSORRESU 's'), qs_cibic (QSCAT 'ADCS-CGIC', QSTESTCD 'ACGC0101'). One record per item; totals are not collected and are not created (derived in ADaM).
MMSE, ADAS-Cog: QSSTRESC = QSORRES, QSSTRESN = numeric. ADCS-CGIC (CIBIC+): QSORRES = box text (codelist CIBIC), QSSTRESC/QSSTRESN = box code 1-7.
Sort by USUBJID, QSCAT, QSTESTCD, VISITNUM; QSSEQ = 1..n within USUBJID.

Map lab.TEST_CODE to LBTESTCD, LBTEST and LBCAT with sheet 'LB Test Map' (CT 2026-03-27 codes and names). Records with STATUS = 'CANCELLED' are dropped (planted P9). USUBJID = '01-' || first 3 characters of PATIENT_ID || '-' || rest.

lab.REQ_VISIT gives the planned visit: SCRN 1, BASE 3, WK02-1D 3.5, WK02 4, WK04 5, WK04+1D 6, WK06 7, WK08 8, WK12 9, WK16 10, WK20 11, WK24 12, WK26 13, RETR 201. Use it when the subject has that VISITNUM in SV (planned or ET), even if the collection date differs from the visit date (e.g. screening labs drawn up to a week before Visit 1). Otherwise, and for UNSCH: VISITNUM of the SV record on the collection date (an unscheduled SV visit first, then the lowest VISITNUM); if none, the latest planned/ET SV visit before the date + .1, + .2 by date (0 before Visit 1). Unscheduled lab collections on a date with no visit page become unscheduled SV visits (see MT.VISIT), so every LB visit exists in SV.
LBSTRESN = numeric value of RESULT_SI; null when the result carries an operator ('<0.2') or is text. LBSTRESC keeps RESULT_SI as sent.
lab.ABN_FLAG: N -> NORMAL, L -> LOW, H -> HIGH, A -> ABNORMAL, blank -> null.
Sort by USUBJID, LBCAT, LBTESTCD, LBDTC; LBSEQ = 1..n within USUBJID.
Numeric part of SCORRES; non-numeric text is removed (e.g. '12 yrs' -> 12). SCSTRESC = SCSTRESN as text. One record per subject with a non-blank EDU_YEARS.
DSSEQ of the parent DS record (DSSCAT = 'STUDY TREATMENT'), as text.
SVENDTC = SVSTDTC. Each visit is done on one day.
Vendor SI unit written as the CT submission value: GI/L -> 10^9/L, TI/L -> 10^12/L, 1 -> L/L (HCT). HBA1CHGB keeps '1' (hemoglobin fraction, no CT unit). fmol(Fe) (MCH) has no CT value and is kept.
Collected on the Study Drug Therapy - Date of Final Dose page (Visit 13 p105 / Early Termination p138), exported as final_dose.csv. Null for 2 subjects with no date recorded.

The CRF collects one 'Origin' code. HP (Hispanic) maps to ETHNIC = HISPANIC OR LATINO with RACE = WHITE; O (mixed parentage, American Indian, Eskimo) maps to RACE = OTHER because no specify text was collected. RACE and ETHNIC codelists were removed from SDTM CT 2026-03-27; the 2025-09-26 codelists are used.
SDTMIG 3.4: ARMCD/ARM/ACTARMCD/ACTARM are null for subjects not assigned or not treated; the reason is in ARMNRS (replaces pre-3.3 codes such as 'Scrnfail').
Coded by the vendor with MedDRA; the vendor file delivers terms only, so the --CD code variables are not submitted.

The AE log is re-recorded at later visits: the same AESPID can appear on several rows that differ in AEDTC. Each row is kept. 705-1199 E06 appears twice with identical CRF fields (source rows differed only in the outcome, which the CRF does not collect); after duplicate removal one row remains - a site query in practice.
AEOUT (outcome) and AEACN (action taken) are not collected on this CRF and are not submitted.
The historical diagnosis page records the date the condition resolved ("Date Recovered/Date of Surgical Procedure"), so it maps to MHENDTC. The Pilot put this date in MHSTDTC.
Weight, height and temperature are collected with a unit checkbox (lb/kg, in/cm, F/C). VSORRES/VSORRESU keep the collected value; VSSTRESN/VSSTRESU are converted to kg, cm and C.

Only MMSE, ADAS-Cog and CIBIC+ are submitted; NPI-X, DAD and Hachinski are annotated on the aCRF but out of scope. CIBIC+ is the ADCS-CGIC and uses CDISC CT (QSCAT 'ADCS-CGIC', QSTESTCD 'ACGC0101'). ADAS-Cog and MMSE keep the Pilot's sponsor-defined QS codes: the CDISC codelists for them (ADAS-Cog CDISC Version, MMSE, both FT) are non-extensible and do not match this CRF's items (ADAS-Cog item 9 Attention/Visual Search Task has no CDISC code; MMSE has no codes for the orientation, registration and recall section scores collected here).
Laboratory data come from the central lab transfer, not the CRF, so LB has no aCRF pages. The lab sends both conventional and SI results; SI results are used as the standard result.
